title: Development of a deep learning model for cancer diagnosis by inspecting cell-free DNA end-motifs.
summary: Across six datasets and an independent lung-cancer test set, EMIT AUROC was compared with a baseline; this remains retrospective biomarker validation without clinical outcome testing. The finding is bounded to the reported study and does not establish causal benefit or generalization.
